rationale: Dorea ferments glucose and lactate as primary carbon sources, with arginine as supplementary substrate. Nitrogen is limiting (4 mmol/gDW/h available supports ~0.57 /h growth). Fermentation produces butyrate, acetate, CO₂, and formate. Carbon balance: 84 mmol C in (60 from glucose + 12 from lactate + 12 from arginine); 78.81 mmol C out (60 fermentation + 18.81 growth). Nitrogen balance: 4 mmol N in supports 4.48 mmol N needed for growth at 0.57 /h.
